create or alter function [dbo].[GetAssetTypeBreadcrumbs] ( @objectType varchar(max), @objectId int ) returns table as return ( with h as ( select 0 as Level, assetType.Name, assetType.ObjectID from dbo.AssetType assetType where assetType.[Object] = @objectType and assetType.ObjectId = @objectId
union all
select child.[Level]-1 as [Level], parentType.Name, parentType.ObjectID from h child inner join dbo.IntersectType intersectType on intersectType.ObjectId = child.ObjectID and intersectType.PredicateID = 9 inner join dbo.AssetType parentType on parentType.ObjectID = intersectType.SubjectID ) select distinct top 1000000 h.Level, h.Name as TypeName from h order by h.Level )
